activities.activity: Sleeping through the night with the air conditioner set to a comfortable temperature
Waking up, washing face, brushing teeth and getting dressed for the day
Making and eating a quick breakfast of toast and coffee, packing a water bottle for the hot day ahead
Changing into work clothes, checking the hospital roster on the phone and packing the work bag
Commuting to the hospital during the morning rush
Working as a hospital physiotherapist: running morning rehabilitation sessions and assisting patients with mobility exercises
Taking a lunch break at the hospital, eating and rehydrating in the air-conditioned staff room
Continuing physiotherapy duties: afternoon patient appointments, treatment notes and coordinating with the care team
Commuting home from the hospital in the lingering heat
Cooking and eating dinner, using the induction cooker and range hood, and drinking plenty of water
Cleaning up after dinner, washing dishes and loading the dishwasher
Taking a cool shower and washing up after a hot working day
Changing into light sleepwear and setting the bedroom air conditioner to a moderate temperature
Relaxing on the couch watching TV, keeping the air conditioner off during the evening peak tax period and relying on ventilation instead
Doing light stretching and mobility exercises to ease the day's physical strain
Nightly wash and brushing teeth before bed
Sleeping with the light off, winding down for an early start the next day
